why: Leo-named fix: a lone chat's link opened in the main pane before the right pane. PaneController's strip syncs from outside its observation (OutboundTab.finish via syncStripFromStore, tabItemChanged) now apply the workspace layout first, as observe already does; the 8 lines are that one private helper and its doc comment in the PaneController that owns those paths.
